verdict.rationale: Steel documents programmatic session management: a Sessions API that spins up isolated browser instances on demand, a session lifecycle with create accepting custom IDs, an OpenAPI spec, and a CLI to start and stop sessions. It also claims users can 'control fleets of browsers in the cloud.' However, nothing in the evidence documents concurrency limits or how many sessions can run in parallel, which is an explicit part of the story. missing for 10: documented concurrency limits/quotas per plan, concrete evidence of running many sessions in parallel, independent or hands-on corroboration of fleet-scale operation.
